titles.title: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 1013) to amend the Federal securities laws to enhance 403(b) plans, and for other purposes.
Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 1013) to amend the Federal securities laws to enhance 403(b) plans, and for other purposes.

action.text: The House Committee on Rules reported an original measure, H. Rept. 119-878, by Mr. Griffith.
Rule provides for consideration of H.R. 1013 with 1 hour of general debate. Previous question shall be considered as ordered except motion to recommit. Bill is closed to amendments.

calendar.text: Placed on the House Calendar, Calendar No. 92.
